info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides access to the status of all retail orders within the system. This endpoint allows users to query the current state of their orders, enabling businesses to monitor order fulfillment and delivery processes effectively. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and retail management systems that require real-time order status updates to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. By integrating this API, stakeholders can ensure timely and accurate updates regarding their orders.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a specified order. You can use this to track orders and update customers on their order fulfillment process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of orders. It accepts a JSON payload that specifies the necessary parameters for the status check.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of the orders request in a string format.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the order operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the specific order operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the order operation.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the order operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the order operation status.

audit.description: Details about the audit information related to the order operation.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_204.description: Represents the response structure for the status of an order operation after a GET request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed by an automated process.

Audit.description: Represents audit information for operations performed.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
